model.recipes_share_problem_unknown_kind: The kind {what} is not one of expression, condition, m409, echo.
model.recipes_share_problem_unbalanced: The formula has an unclosed bracket or quote.
model.recipes_share_problem_m409_path: A path for M409 has no spaces, operators or quotes.
model.recipes_share_problem_hole_unused: The blank {what} is described but not in the formula.
model.recipes_share_problem_hole_name: The blank {what} needs a name in lower case letters.
model.recipes_share_problem_unknown_hole_type: {field}: the type {what} is not one of the blank types.
model.recipes_share_problem_since_format: The firmware version must look like 3.4.
model.recipes_share_problem_since_old: The firmware version {what} is older than RepRapFirmware 3.
model.recipes_share_problem_unknown_result: The answer {what} is not one of number, bool, string, array, object, null.
model.recipes_share_problem_condition_result: A condition answers true or false (bool), not {what}.
model.recipes_share_problem_example_hole: The example still has the blank {what}.
model.recipes_share_problem_example_mismatch: The example is not the formula with its blanks filled.
model.recipes_share_problem_author_format: The author must be a GitHub user name (letters, digits and hyphens).
model.recipes_share_problem_tag_format: The tag {what} must be lower case letters, digits and hyphens.
model.guided_assist_what: The blanks of a form, one at a time: what each one asks for and the choices this board has for it.
model.guided_assist_why: To fill a form without guessing what goes in each place: a number, a text, a path, an axis that exists on this machine.
model.guided_assist_missing: You type over each blank by hand and the board tells you afterwards when something made no sense.
model.guided_assist_help: Tap a choice, or type a value and press Enter. While a blank is selected, Tab goes to the next one and Shift+Tab to the previous one. The command cannot be sent while a blank is left.
model.guided_checks_what: What the plugin sees wrong in the expression before it is sent: types that do not match, a function it does not know, a list position past the end, a path the model does not have.
model.guided_checks_why: To catch what makes no sense before the board does, with the reason in plain words.
model.guided_checks_missing: You find out from the error text of the board.
model.guided_checks_help: A problem blocks Send until it is fixed; a warning or a note only says what to check. A function the plugin does not know is not a problem when the board runs a firmware newer than the catalog of this plugin: it is sent as written.
model.guided_left: Blanks still to fill: {n}. The first is {what}.
model.guided_pick_path: Pick a path of the model
model.guided_hole_number_how: Type it (decimals with a dot), or pick a path of the model whose value is a number.
model.guided_hole_angle: An angle in radians goes here.
model.guided_hole_angle_how: Type it, or tap radians( ) and give the degrees.
model.guided_hole_text_how: Type it; the quotes are added for you. Or pick a path whose value is a text.
model.guided_hole_file: The name of a file on the SD card goes here.
model.guided_hole_file_how: Type it with its folder, for example 0:/sys/config.g.
model.guided_hole_bool_how: Tap true or false, or pick a path whose value is true or false.
model.guided_hole_value: Any value goes here: a number, a text, true or false, a path.
model.guided_hole_value_how: Type it or pick a path of the model.
model.guided_hole_path: A path of the model goes here.
model.guided_hole_path_how: Pick it in the Paths tab or type it, for example state.status.
model.guided_hole_array_how: Tap one of the lists of the model or type its path.
model.guided_hole_index: A position in the list goes here, counting from 0.
model.guided_hole_index_how: Tap one of the items the list has now, or type the position.
model.guided_hole_axis: The number of an axis goes here.
model.guided_hole_axis_how: Tap one of the axes this board has.
model.guided_hole_heater: The number of a heater goes here.
model.guided_hole_heater_how: Tap one of the heaters this board has.
model.guided_hole_tool: The number of a tool goes here.
model.guided_hole_tool_how: Tap one of the tools this board has.
model.guided_hole_fan: The number of a fan goes here.
model.guided_hole_fan_how: Tap one of the fans this board has.
model.guided_hole_global: The name of a global goes here.
model.guided_hole_global_how: Tap one of the globals the board has now, or type a name.
model.guided_hole_name: The name of a variable of the macro goes here.
model.guided_hole_name_how: Type the name you gave it with var name = value.
model.guided_hole_letter: The letter of a parameter of the macro goes here.
model.guided_hole_letter_how: Type the letter, for example S for param.S.
model.guided_check_concat_type: {what} is {got}: joining it into a text may not work on the board.
model.guided_check_compare_types: {what} compares {left} with {right}: compare numbers with numbers and text with text.
model.guided_check_hash_type: {what} is {got}: # counts the items of a list or the characters of a text.
model.guided_check_index_not_list: {what} is {got}, not a list, so [ ] cannot pick an item from it.
model.guided_check_index_not_number: The position {what} is {got}; a position is a number from 0.
model.guided_check_index_out_of_range: {what} has {n} items: positions go from 0 to {max}.
model.guided_check_function_unknown: RRF {version} has no function {what}; see the Math, Angles and Lists groups of the catalog.
model.guided_check_function_maybe_newer: {what} is not in the catalog of this plugin, but the board runs RRF {version}, newer than what the catalog covers: it may be a newer function. It is sent as written.
model.guided_check_exists_not_path: exists() needs a name such as global.x or a path of the model, not {what}.
model.guided_check_path_missing: {what} is not in the model now.
model.guided_check_path_missing_closest: {what} is not in the model now. Did you mean {closest}?
model.guided_check_macro_only: {what} only has a value inside a macro: from here the board will say it does not exist.
model.guided_check_bad_operator: {what} is not an operator of RRF: use && for and, the doubled vertical bar for or, = to compare, ^ to join text.
model.guided_check_single_quote: Texts go between double quotes, not single ones.
model.guided_check_leftover: {what} is left over at the end: an operator is missing before it.
model.guided_check_branches_differ: The two results of ? : are of different types ({left} and {right}).
model.guided_blocked: Problems to fix before it can be sent: {n}.
model.guided_fit_in_string: The cursor is inside a text: nothing of the catalog fits there. Move it outside the quotes first.
model.guided_fit_hole_word: This blank is a name you type, not a value: no form fits in it.
model.guided_fit_hole_path: This blank wants a path of the model: only a path fits in it.
model.guided_fit_selection_word: The first blank of {form} is a name you type: it cannot take the selection.
model.guided_fit_selection_path: The first blank of {form} wants a path of the model, and the selection is not one.
model.guided_fit_some: Forms that do not fit where the cursor is: {n}, dimmed. Tap Insert on one to read why.
model.guided_only_type: Only the paths whose value is {type}, for the blank {what}.
model.look_nav_hint_tree: The live model of the board, by topic or as a tree
model.look_nav_hint_globals: Your own variables: see and change them
model.look_nav_hint_presets: Named sets of globals to apply later
model.look_nav_hint_snapshots: A copy of the model to compare later
model.look_nav_hint_usage: Which files read or write each global
model.look_nav_hint_tester: Try an expression on the board
model.look_nav_hint_alerts: A warning when a value crosses a limit
model.look_nav_hint_report: A text about the machine for support
model.look_pins_hint: Tap one to see it; the cross takes it out.
model.look_pins_empty_more: Starred globals show up here too.
model.look_globals_lead: Your own variables on the board: numbers, switches and texts that your macros read.
model.look_sort_help: Tap to change the order: name, type or last change
model.look_globals_empty_text: A global is a value with a name that lives on the board: a focus height, a mode, a switch. Your macros and panels read it, and you can change it from here.
model.look_globals_empty_config: You can also write it in config.g: global name = value
model.look_globals_nomatch_text: Try a shorter name or clear the filters.
model.look_globals_off_title: Globals are off on this board
model.look_globals_readonly: You can look but not change: your role is read only.
model.look_card_novalue_help: This global exists but holds nothing yet. It is not an error.
model.look_card_filler_unknown: Run the usage finder to see which file sets it.
model.look_card_filler_none: No file read so far sets it.
model.look_edit_novalue_hint: This global has no value yet. Type one to set it.
model.look_edit_hint_empty: Type a value to see the command.
model.look_creator_lead: Three steps: a name, a type and a value. The exact command is shown before it goes to the board.
model.look_creator_name_help: Letters, digits and underscore, starting with a letter: laserFocus, probe_offset.
model.look_creator_name_taken: A global with this name already exists: the board would refuse to create it again. Change it from its card instead.
model.look_creator_type_pick: What kind of value is it?
model.look_creator_command: This is the command that will be sent
model.look_creator_done: Created: {name}. It is now in the list.
model.look_creator_keep_hint: To keep it after a restart, mark it from its card once created.
model.look_ctype_number_what: A whole or decimal number, like 12 or 7.5.
model.look_ctype_number_why: Heights, speeds, powers, counts: most globals are numbers.
model.look_ctype_number_missing: Saved as a text, the macros cannot add it or compare it.
model.look_ctype_number_help: Type the number; a point makes it decimal (7.5), without it the board keeps a whole number (7).
model.look_ctype_bool_what: A switch: on or off, true or false.
model.look_ctype_bool_why: A flag a macro checks: laser armed, door closed, test mode.
model.look_ctype_bool_missing: A number 0 or 1 works but reads worse in a condition.
model.look_ctype_bool_help: Pick on or off; the macros read it as: if global.name
model.look_ctype_string_what: Any text, like a mode or a file name.
model.look_ctype_string_why: Names, modes, messages the macros show.
model.look_ctype_string_missing: A number cannot hold a word.
model.look_ctype_string_help: Write the text without quotes; the plugin adds them in the command.
model.look_ctype_array_why: Offsets per tool, positions per corner, one value per axis.
model.look_ctype_array_missing: You would need one global per value.
model.look_ctype_array_help: Separate the values with commas: 1, 2.5, "text"; the macros read them as global.name[0].
model.look_ctype_expression_what: A formula the board works out when the command runs, like move.axes[0].max - 5.
model.look_ctype_expression_why: A value taken from the machine at that moment.
model.look_ctype_expression_missing: You type the result by hand and it goes stale.
model.look_ctype_expression_help: Write it as RRF would read it; it is sent as written. The Expression tester helps you try it first.
model.look_name_default_hint: A name is ready; write your own if you prefer.
model.look_name_custom_hint: Your name. Clear the field to get the suggested one back.
model.look_name_invalid: The name needs 1 to 40 characters in one line and cannot start with a space.
model.look_export_names_hint: The date and time are those of the moment you press the button.
model.look_loading_list: Reading the file of the board...
model.look_snapshots_lead: A copy of the model at one moment, to compare with another moment or with now.
model.look_snapshots_empty_text: Save one before a change (a new config.g, a firmware update, a job) and compare afterwards.
model.look_snapshots_more: More about the budget and the file
model.look_scope_chips: Parts of the model at one tap
model.look_scope_chip_selected: Use what I selected in Model: {path}
model.look_scope_chip_selected_help: The path selected in the Model section: {path}
model.look_scope_chip_root_help: A root branch of the model: {path}
model.look_scope_pick_hint: Pick a part of the model: a chip above or the search.
model.look_scope_words_part_cut: Only {path} - the first {n} values (the budget of this machine)
model.look_scope_words_missing: {path} is not in the model right now.
model.look_presets_lead: A named set of all your globals: save how they are now and bring them back later.
model.look_presets_empty_text: Set your globals the way you like for a job, save them as a preset and bring them back with one tap.
model.look_presets_no_globals: There is no global to save yet.
model.look_preset_compare_lead: What the preset would change on the machine, line by line, and the command that applies it.
model.look_watch_lead: Values you chose to follow, with their line of the last minutes.
model.look_watch_empty_text: Open a value in the Model section and tap Watch, or use the menu of a global.
model.look_changes_empty_text: When a global or a watched value changes, it shows up here with the value before and after.
model.look_export_lead: Download what you watched as a CSV or JSON file.
model.look_alerts_lead: A banner on every section when a value crosses a limit you set.
model.look_report_lead: A text with the facts of the machine, ready to paste in the forum or an issue.

startup.row_connection_what: DWC is talking to the board (standalone) or to DSF (SBC mode).
startup.row_connection_for: Everything on this page reads the live object model through that connection.
startup.row_connection_missing: Without it there is no tree, no globals and no files to read.
startup.row_connection_tip: Check the network or the USB cable and that DWC shows the machine as connected.
startup.miss_connection: DWC is not connected to the board
startup.row_firmware_what: RepRapFirmware 3.4 or newer on the main board.
startup.row_firmware_for: Global variables, set, exists() and the persistence macro need it.
startup.row_firmware_missing: The tree, the watch list and the path helper keep working; the globals features stay off.
startup.row_firmware_tip: Update the firmware of the board from Settings > General (upload the firmware file) and restart it.
startup.row_include_what: One line of config.g runs 0:/sys/workshop-globals.g, the macro this plugin writes with the kept globals.
startup.row_include_for: The kept globals come back with their saved value every time the board starts.
startup.row_include_missing: The globals are lost on every reboot and the macros that read them fail until something creates them again.
startup.row_include_tip: Open config.g in Files > System, add the line after the hardware is configured, save and restart.
startup.include_missing: not called from config.g ({n} globals kept)
startup.include_step1: Open Files > System and edit config.g.
startup.include_step2: Paste the line below after the hardware is configured (near the end is fine).
startup.include_step3: Save, restart the board and tap Check.
startup.row_sbc_what: With the Duet in SBC mode and DSF 3.4 or newer this page turns on, by itself and from the browser: the watch history saved in 0:/sys/workshop-model-watch.json, a wider budget for the usage finder, and the sbc.* and plugins.* branches of the model.
startup.row_sbc_for: They use the disk of the Pi through DSF, which is cheap to write. They need no plugin on the Pi: the companion is a separate, optional row.
startup.row_sbc_missing: The three extras stay off and the page bar says why; everything else works the same.
startup.row_sbc_tip: Nothing to do: it turns on by itself when the board runs with DSF. With an old DSF, update DSF on the Pi.
startup.sbc_ok: on (watch history file, wider usage finder, sbc and plugins branches)
startup.sbc_limited: SBC found but the extras are off (see the page bar)
startup.title: Start-up
startup.state_na: does not apply to your machine
startup.make_tip: Copies the example to the SD card. It never overwrites a file that already exists.
startup.edit_tip: Opens the file in the DWC editor.
startup.hide_tip: Hides this row on this screen. It does not delete anything.
startup.service_tip: It has to be running: it makes the examples and answers the buttons of this plugin.
startup.assist_tip: Walks you through what is missing, one thing at a time. You can skip what you do not need.
startup.assist_no_action: This cannot be fixed with a file from here. Read the explanation and, when you have it, tap "Check again".
startup.assist_done_ready: Everything you went through is ready.
startup.assist_done_left: {n} left to do. You can start again whenever you like.
startup.create_help_tip: Asks a few questions and builds the file. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
startup.questions_intro: Answer and I will build the file. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
startup.err_range: The number is outside the allowed range.
startup.err_chars: Do not use quotes, semicolons or line breaks.
startup.err_pattern: It does not have the expected format. See the help of this field.
startup.warn_moves: {n} line(s) that move the machine were commented out with ";". Check them and remove the ";" only when you are sure and the machine is free.
startup.warn_active: Lines without ";" really run when you use the button.
startup.plan_example: {file} only has the example (all commented). It is replaced by this one, and the previous text is kept in {backup}.
startup.plan_new: {file} already has your configuration and I will not overwrite it. This one will be saved apart as {target}; when you have checked it, rename it in Files > Macros.
startup.verify_ok: Done: the file exists, has active instructions and the plugin already sees it.
startup.verify_new: Saved as {file}. The plugin keeps using the previous file until you swap the names.
startup.verify_comments: {file} was saved, but all its lines are still commented, so the plugin still takes it as an example. That may be what you wanted.
startup.verify_notseen: {file} was saved, but the plugin does not see it as ready yet. Tap "Check again" in a few seconds.
startup.verify_missing: I could not read {file} back. Tap "Check again" to verify it.
startup.verify_fail: It could not be saved ({error}). Nothing was changed.
startup.plan_changed: The file changed while you were answering. Check again what is going to happen and confirm once more.
startup.modal_hint: Tap a card to set it up, or let it walk you through step by step.
startup.modal_sub: Get ready what this plugin needs from your machine
startup.row_companion_what: An optional second plugin that runs on the Raspberry Pi in SBC mode, next to DSF.
startup.row_companion_for: It adds what needs a process while the browser is closed: history of the watched values, phone alerts, snapshots at the start and the end of a job, and a check at boot.
startup.row_companion_missing: Nothing breaks: Model Explorer works fully without it; only those four extras are not there.
startup.row_companion_tip: Install it from Settings > Plugins (Install plugin) with the WorkshopModelAgent zip and start it. It needs a Duet in SBC mode.
startup.companion_stopped: installed but stopped: start it in Settings > Plugins
startup.companion_no_sbc: needs a Duet in SBC mode (optional)
